commands.name: /add-dir
commands.description: Add a directory path to the active workspace.

commands.name: /agents
commands.description: Open the Agent Manager panel to switch custom agents and monitor background subagents.

commands.name: /artifact
commands.description: Open the Artifact Review panel.

commands.name: /boost
commands.description: Run on-demand multi-agent deep reasoning loops.

commands.name: /browser
commands.description: Delegate web browsing, UI verification, and in-browser debugging to the browser subagent.

commands.name: /btw
commands.description: Ask a side question in the background without interrupting the main conversation.

commands.name: /changelog
commands.description: Open the interactive release notes viewer or print CLI changes in headless mode.

commands.name: /clear
commands.description: Clear the terminal and reset active conversation contexts.

commands.name: /codesearch
commands.description: Open the interactive Code Search panel to search code across the workspace.

commands.name: /config
commands.description: Open the interactive Settings Editor overlay.

commands.name: /context
commands.description: Open the context usage visualization panel.

commands.name: /credits
commands.description: View remaining G1 credits and purchase links.

commands.name: /diff
commands.description: Open the interactive diff viewer to view changes, turns, and commits.

commands.name: /effort
commands.description: Set or inspect the active model’s reasoning effort level (low through max, depending on the model).

commands.name: /exit
commands.description: Close the TUI session and restore your host shell.

commands.name: /feedback
commands.description: Open the feedback submission panel.

commands.name: /fork
commands.description: Clone the current conversation thread into a new parallel session.

commands.name: /goal
commands.description: Run autonomously until the goal is verified complete, without intermediate pauses.

commands.name: /grill-me
commands.description: Have the agent interview you one question at a time, with a recommended answer for each, before it starts work.

commands.name: /help
commands.description: Open the help panel showing commands and shortcuts.

commands.name: /hooks
commands.description: Browse active pre-flight/post-format script hooks.

commands.name: /keybindings
commands.description: Open the interactive Keyboard Shortcut Editor.

commands.name: /learn
commands.description: Capture session corrections as persistent rules or skills through a reviewable proposal.

commands.name: /logout
commands.description: Disconnect your profile and purge authentication tokens from the secure keyring.

commands.name: /mcp
commands.description: Open the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server manager.

commands.name: /model
commands.description: Choose your preferred reasoning model (persists across sessions).

commands.name: /open
commands.description: Force the path to open inside your default system editor.

commands.name: /permissions
commands.description: Open the interactive tool permissions manager panel.

commands.name: /plan
commands.description: Explore the codebase, clarify requirements, and draft a reviewable Implementation Plan.

commands.name: /plugin
commands.description: Open the interactive Plugins Manager or run inline install, uninstall, enable, disable, and list commands.

commands.name: /remote-control
commands.description: Toggle Remote Control for the active terminal session.

commands.description: Rename the current session thread.

commands.name: /resume
commands.description: Open the conversation picker overlay to select and load previous threads.

commands.name: /rewind
commands.description: Roll back your conversation history to a previous message.

commands.name: /schedule

commands.name: /skills
commands.description: Browse loaded local and global Agent Skills.

commands.name: /statusline
commands.description: Open the Status Bar customization overlay.

commands.description: Open the Task Manager panel to monitor background shell execution logs.

commands.description: Launch collaborative multi-agent teams for long-horizon projects (paid plans).

commands.name: /title
commands.description: Toggle or set terminal window title updates.

commands.name: /usage
commands.description: Display model quota usage.

commands.name: /voice
commands.description: Dictate a prompt using your microphone.
